purpose: Describe an action as easy to perform.
keywords: This book is easy to read.
These shoes are easy to walk in.
The road is slippery on rainy days.
restrictions: It conjugates as an い-adjective; some uses describe a tendency to happen.
mistake: Use 読みやすい, not 読むやすい.

segments.role: Describe an action as easy to perform. ます-stem + やすい.
